name: Thalamus v4
description: Routes each model call, ranks the assistant's skills, recipes and plugins for each task, and records what it would have done. Loads by default. Mode shadow by default; it computes and records and changes nothing; only enforce hands the agent a short list.

mode.description: off = load nothing and open nothing; shadow = compute and record the per-call decision and the short list, change nothing; enforce = hand the agent the short list.

enabled.description: Ask Jev at all. Off: every read comes from local rules. With no token, nothing is asked whatever this says.

sendRealSituations.description: Real conversations may go to Jev. Synthetic cases always may.

tokenHelpUrl.description: Where to get a Jev token. Shown in the start line and the status; no default.

confidenceFloor.description: Below this Jev confidence an answer is unsure and the cautious option is taken.

privateSources.description: Sources whose content goes only to approved providers, and never to Jev unless approved below.

table.description: Vendor by topic class: allow or deny.

budgetMs.description: How long the prompt waits for the short list before going without it (ms). Was 800 until 2026-10-06; the ledger now records why a list was local, so the value can be chosen from counts.

rank.description: Build the short list from one ranked result per task (recall, then Jev's USE and INSPIRE split) that Broca's matcher reads too. Off: the old flat read of every card.

anticipate.description: The note and past-chat pointers of the anticipation note: for an owner's prompt in a Tinker tab or the main chat, one line each to a note file or an earlier session that may already hold what the task needs. Local word matching only; nothing is sent to any model.

mode.description: off = find nothing; watch = find the pointers and record them in the ledger (enh_uses.pointers_json), show the agent nothing; inject = also add them to the short list's note, which only happens when mode is enforce and enforce.shortlist is on. A misspelt value is off.

noteDirs.description: Folders of Markdown note files, read two levels deep; a frontmatter description is the note's use key. Empty: the agent workspace's memory folder. MEMORY.md and dated daily logs are never pointed at.

chatCatalog.description: The chat catalogue the ask-session skill builds (SQLite). Default $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/ask-session/catalog.sqlite. An empty string switches the past-chat leg off; a missing file is silent.

maxChats.description: Past-chat pointers per prompt, 0 to 3. The note never carries more than 3 pointers in 600 characters in all.

wake.description: The harness asks a strongly matching past chat itself: it runs the ask-session skill's `sessions.py ask <id> "<prompt>" --wake-id` in the background (read-only wake, dated wake-up note, refused when a live tab holds the session), puts one line with the command that prints the answer on the desk, and hands an answer the agent never read over at the start of that chat's next turn, once, as testimony with the files it names checked against the disk. A wake costs about 1.25x the woken session's context on the owner's subscription.

mode.description: off = never; watch = decide as on would and record it on the pointer's ledger row (enh_uses.pointers_json, field wake), start nothing; on = also wake, only when the pointer is shown (mode enforce, enforce.shortlist, anticipate.mode inject). A misspelt value is off.

minCover.description: Share of the prompt's information the past chat must cover to be woken, 0.45 to 1 (a pointer needs 0.45).

minTerms.description: Distinct rare words the prompt and the past chat must share to wake it, 3 to 8 (a pointer needs 3).

dailyCap.description: Wakes the harness starts per local day, 0 to 50, counted from the result files on disk so a restart does not reset it.

timeoutS.description: Seconds before the skill stops a wake, 20 to 300.

refreshCatalog.description: The gateway keeps the default past-chat catalogue fresh with the ask-session skill's own incremental scan: once a night (02:00-06:00) when the last run is over 20 h old, at any hour past 48 h, and once a few minutes after start when there is no catalogue yet. No model, no wake. A custom chatCatalog is never refreshed.

lessons.description: The nightly lesson pass (thalamus.lessons.run, called by the bundled sleep routine): the owner's repeated corrections are grouped into lessons, each lesson's rule is found on disk (saved note, task notes, a file read every turn), the cause of the slip is sorted into not loaded, contradicted or vague, and a repair is drafted. Only a rule that was in view, clear and unopposed, and still broken moves up, to a drafted check that starts watch-only. Writes under <dataDir>/lessons/.

mode.description: off = keep no corrections and run no pass; watch = keep the corrections (redacted, local), draft the repairs and write the ledger and the report, change no rule file; apply = also add the concrete rule line to target when the repair can only tighten. A repair that strikes or scopes an existing line always waits for the owner. A misspelt value is off.

minSlips.description: Corrections of the same thing that make a lesson. The second correction means the first lesson failed.

windowHours.description: How far back the first pass reads corrections. Later passes read from the previous pass.

alwaysRead.description: Files read with every turn (rung 3). Empty: the workspace's AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, USER.md, IDENTITY.md and MEMORY.md.

taskDirs.description: Folders of task notes, skills and recipes (rung 2), read two levels deep. Empty: the workspace's skills folder.

noteDirs.description: Folders of saved notes (rung 1), read two levels deep. Empty: the anticipation note's note folders.

target.description: The always-read file apply adds a rule line to, under '## Lessons from the nightly pass'. Default: the workspace's AGENTS.md.

retentionDays.description: Decisions older than this are pruned.

digest.description: Enforce only: a reader condenses long text tool results, the raw result kept on disk under a name.

check.description: Enforce only: a model of another family checks a run that commits to something or claims a fact before it finishes.

finish.description: Enforce only: one writer puts the words the user reads of a run that several models worked on.

workerAgents.description: Enforce only, Claude Code lane: hand the bridge worker --agents sub-agents from the plugin.

workerModel.description: Enforce only, Claude Code lane: let the plugin set the worker's model per turn.

perCall.description: Enforce only: the embedded lane replaces the model per call. The call seam only observes today, so this records the owner's decision and acts when the seam can replace a model.

midThread.description: Enforce only: a running thread may be switched at all. Off: only fresh points (a new unit, a check, a finish, a digest) switch.

hedge.description: Enforce only: a second copy of a slow critical-path unit on another provider; the first answer wins. Shadow records the hedge it would send and sends nothing.

orchestrateAuto.description: Enforce only: model "auto" in an orchestrate script resolves to a routed claude-code model instead of the default leaf model.

ownModelChoices.description: Enforce only: Thalamus picks every model that used to be fixed (a leaf with no model, a sub-agent spawned with no model, the Claude roles of a round-table), each keeping its fixed model as the fallback. A model named on purpose is never replaced.

shortlist.description: Enforce only: hand the agent the enhancement short list on every prompt and answer the Claude Code hook route with it. Off: enforce routes but injects no list, as shadow does.

providerCaps.description: Concurrent calls per provider, so a fan-out never queues behind itself.

margin.description: A copy starts when a critical-path unit has run this multiple of its usual time.

allowedLeafProviders.description: Providers model "auto" may pick from in an orchestrate script. Widening it changes billing exposure, so it is the owner's.

enabled.description: The nightly run may write its estimates, rung times and card versions. A dry run never writes.

apply.description: The router uses the learned estimates in place of the public map alone.

explore.description: Overnight jobs, at most five per cent of their calls, try an option the router would not normally take.

shuffle.description: Enforce only: overnight short lists are shown in a shuffled order so the loop can measure how much the agent follows position.

replayMaxChars.description: Characters of a redacted task kept for replay.

tutor.description: The tutors (2026-10-25): after a run, a second model judges whether the model that ran fit the task (table routing_reviews) and whether the enhancement list fit it (enh_reviews). Records only; nothing routes or ranks differently. A private source is never sent.

ladder.description: provider/model rungs, tried in order. Default: claude-code/claude-sonnet-5-5, then claude-code/claude-haiku-4-5.

sampleRate.description: Share of eligible runs taken, so each day's cap spreads over the day.

followUpMs.description: How long a routing review waits for the owner's next prompt, which shows a correction.
